definitions.engine_breakout: previous_season_finish is None or > 13, AND this season positional finish <= 12 (copied from the breakout engine; rank 13 is not a non-starter)
definitions.first_time_elite: not previously_top12 AND this season positional finish <= 12
definitions.prior_rank_source: Phase 1 previous_season_finish (last observed prior season, not a calendar year-1 join)
definitions.prime_window_method: smoothed P(top-12 | integer age, position) >= known-age position baseline and n >= 15; longest consecutive run
definitions.missing_exp: omitted from career-stage cohorts, not labeled rookie
definitions.missing_capital: omitted from draft-capital cohorts, not labeled UDFA
definitions.missing_usage: omitted from prior-usage cohorts, not bucketed as 0
definitions.missing_comp_dimension: omitted from matching; not 0 / UDFA / last-place. Rookie prior_finish is the explicit label none
definitions.comps: P(this-season hit | pre-season profile). Matching uses position, career stage, draft capital, prior finish, age bucket, previous-season usage. Same-season actuals, ADP, and projections are not features. Tiny cells relax in COMP_RELAXATION_ORDER and shrink toward the position baseline. Named comps exclude the query player. Rates are pooled historical, not walk-forward. Request path reads precomputed JSON leaves; no parquet scan, no 031_* table
definitions.prior_usage: P(this-season hit | previous-season usage bucket); same-season NGS/snaps are outcomes, not features

prime_window.method: smoothed P(tier | integer age, position) >= position baseline among known-age seasons, and sample_size >= 15 (not low confidence); window = longest consecutive qualifying ages, ties broken by successes
